issue.title: Script commands ending in .cmd or .bat fail with INTERNAL_ERROR spawn EINVAL instead of PROCESS_START_FAILED
issue.body:
Found by WP-F5 (#102 launch diagnosis) and confirmed by its independent GPT-6.1 Sol review on 2026-10-19 through the public engine interfaces. Outside every I01 to I07 bolt; filed for triage.

## Defect

A script node whose command is a Windows `.cmd` or `.bat` file (for example `npm.cmd`, bare or absolute) fails with `INTERNAL_ERROR: spawn EINVAL` instead of the typed `PROCESS_START_FAILED` result.

## Steps

1. On Windows, publish a loop with a script node whose command is `npm.cmd` (or any `.cmd`/`.bat` path) and run it.

Expected: the node fails with the typed start failure `PROCESS_START_FAILED` and the documented resumability, as it does for a missing executable.

Actual: `ProcessScripts.run` rejects with a raw `spawn EINVAL`; through the engine the run fails `INTERNAL_ERROR: spawn EINVAL`, `resumable: true`, with no normal script progress event.

## Cause

At `packages/infrastructure/src/process/scripts.ts:58`, Node's `spawn` throws synchronously inside the Promise executor for `.cmd`/`.bat` commands (Node refuses to spawn batch files without a shell), so the error never reaches the start-failure result path.

## Fix shape

Normalise synchronous start errors through the existing start-failure result path; keep `shell: false`. Explicit shell invocation by the author remains the supported way to run batch files; this issue is only about truthful failure containment.

## Related

#102 (WP-F5 record `docs/qa/2026-10-19-wp-f5-launch-diagnosis.md`), #224 (force-stop truthfulness, WP-C7).


## Intent 4 delivery admission — November 21

Admitted after [intent 3 engineering delivery](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/279#issuecomment-7059784448) on signed main `02351e2fb932b3be44e7cc3fb3943a61d568226c`, under the owner's ordered batch and delegated blocker-decision authority. [D171 and its alternatives](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/427#issuecomment-7059806202) distinguish coordinator selection from human plan approval. Historical parking text above remains history.

Reconcile the existing PR375 synchronous spawn/EINVAL fix and current SCRIPT_START_FAILED contract with independent native and composed public QA. An evidence-backed already-fixed disposition is valid; do not manufacture a replacement fix or restore retired naming.

Implementation and opposite-family review use the named routing models at xhigh. **Independent QA agent (planned):** `i4_362_behavior_qa`, a separate context and checkout; actual provider/session/build/evidence will be recorded when dispatched. GPT owns architecture; Claude Code contributes implementation, design critique, QA and adversarial review. Preserve touched-system positive/negative QA, unchanged coverage, current-head/current-target CI, fresh independent Astra MAX final audit and the three-general-scan cap. No implementation, QA or acceptance is implied by admission. Owner-only closure obligations and held460/Mac501 remain separate.
